title: Posting of license.
bodyText: Each foreign bank that is licensed to establish and maintain a Hawaii state branch, Hawaii state agency, or Hawaii representative office shall post its license in a conspicuous place at the office.
bodyHtml: [§412:13-219]  Posting of license.  Each foreign bank that is licensed to establish and maintain a Hawaii state branch, Hawaii state agency, or Hawaii representative office shall post its license in a conspicuous place at the office. [L 1996, c 155, pt of §2]
